what: Every PR opened through .github/workflows/pr-opener.yml starts with ZERO check runs and stays ungradeable until a human-credentialled actor pushes an extra commit. MEASURED 2026-09-03 on three separate PRs from one session -- #10918, #10923 and #10933 -- each returning `get_check_runs total_count: 0` after the relay opened it, and each needing a hand-made EMPTY commit to become gradeable. POPULATION: 3 of 3 relay-opened PRs this session; 3 of 3 needed the workaround. The cause is documented in pr-opener.yml's own header: the PR is opened by github-actions[bot] under GITHUB_TOKEN, which fires no `pull_request` event, and the bot's own results commit fires no `push` event either.
